artifact_identity_note: This publisher emits single-platform OCI image manifests, never an OCI index. services/build/internal/build/runner.go ReadManifest requests only application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json and application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json and rejects anything else with "single-platform image manifest required". The digest above is therefore the platform manifest identity itself. There is no index identity and no platform child manifest to compare it against; an index digest and a platform child manifest digest are two different identities and neither may stand in for the other.

build_inputs.note: Build inputs are not delivered components. They are the material the build consumed; none of them runs as a service of the delivered artifact, and none of them may be presented as part of the delivery.

runtime_base_image.role: the base the agent was built FROM; its layers are already inside the delivered manifest
runtime_base_image.substitute_note: Built locally from deploy/portable/qualification-workspace.Dockerfile (no RUN, no network). It stands in for the platform's published OPL App runtime image and is not one.

webui_image.role: static webui bundled into the agent image at /opt/opl/web

dockerfile_frontend_image.role: the # syntax= frontend the recipe names

build_recipe_blob.role: the recipe tar; its Dockerfile must be byte-identical to the product's Runner.FixedDockerfile rendering

previous_retained.note: No previous version of this artifact exists, so nothing is retained as a predecessor. The other four build jobs that produced the same digest (build_5ac665396e9ca855ff14050ad4a4a90d, build_8ba22ee027126a23682856f460882956, build_236fbafb12c5ab6ceefa4a96c50a364b, build_f210cc4fa898316424f2c658efdaa352) are the SAME artifact under different job ids, not retained versions. Retaining a predecessor requires a distinct digest.

historical_must_not_be_presented_as_deli.note: Two digests exist in this installation that must never be presented as this delivery.

runtime_base_image.reason: It is the base the agent was built FROM, not the agent. The delivered manifest already contains its layers.

qualification_workspace_fixture.reason: The same digest as the runtime base image. Its CMD serves the platform fixture body 'OPL Workspace READY'; the delivered agent's entrypoint is the agent package's own runtime instead. A served body of 'OPL Workspace READY' is proof that the platform fixture is being served and the agent is not.

capabilities.application_access: anonymous; the delivered revision declares exposurePolicy=anonymous and the runtime contract declares applicationAccess.mode=anonymous
capabilities.serves: the agent package's own runtime at /opt/opl/bin/runtime (entrypoint), cmd=serve
capabilities.data_mount: /data, mount name workspace-data, concurrent writers not supported
capabilities.data_schema_version: opl-package/v1, rollback safe within opl-package/v1, upgrade mode compatible
capabilities.readback: GET / on the served URL returns the agent's own JSON body

readback_method: authenticated registry query of the pushed tag after publication, plus the OCI manifest child listing: read the manifest by tag, list its config digest and every layer digest, then read the config blob to confirm os/architecture and the entrypoint. The listing is of the manifest's config and layers; there is no OCI index child listing to perform, because this publisher emits single-platform image manifests and the build owner rejects an index with 'single-platform image manifest required'. The build owner requires the response Docker-Content-Digest to equal the digest of the manifest bytes it read, and requires the image config's os/architecture to equal the declared platform, before it accepts the artifact.
